news.story: Hall reached 100 scrimmage yards for the second consecutive game while scoring his first touchdown since Week 1 on a seven-yard reception in the second quarter. Both Hall and Braelon Allen (17 touches for 84 yards) were heavily involved as the Jets snapped a five-game losing streak and were able to stick with the ground game. news.story: "Obviously, [Hall] and Garrett Wilson are guys that we really try to target for the most part...Hall will end up getting a tick more [touches] because, again, he's our starting running back," Glenn said Friday. news.headline: Allen rushed 16 times for 75 yards while catching his lone target for nine yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
news.story: Allen's 16 carries matched his total from the previous two games combined, as he had seen a downtick in opportunities since fellow RB Breece Hall returned from a quadriceps injury. Hall led the backfield once again with 100 scrimmage yards and a touchdown on 23 touches, but Allen was a key part of the game plan as well in the run-heavy win. The Jets will face a one-win team for a second consecutive game in Week 12…

Diggs (personal) was removed from the Commanders' injury report Thursday.
news.story: Diggs had an excused absence Wednesday but avoided the injury report entirely one day later, setting him up to continue to serve as Washington's clear-cut No. 1 wide receiver. Since Terry McLaurin was lost for the season due to a torn patellar tendon that he suffered in Week 6 at San Francisco, Diggs has compiled a 16-217-2 line on 27 targets over the last four games.

news.headline: Diggs was absent from Wednesday's practice and was excused, Ben Standig of The Team 980 reports.
news.story: Diggs was away from the team for Wednesday's session due to a personal issue. There's no indication this will be a long-term absence, and the Commanders did excuse him for Wednesday. Still, Diggs' return to the team will be worth monitoring over the coming days in advance of Sunday's game at Arizona.

Allen totaled three catches (on four targets) for 38 yards during Sunday's 35-10 victory against the Vikings in Mexico City.
news.story: Sunday marked Allen's first time working with Mike Evans, the 49ers' top wide receiver, and the latter dominated the attention of QB Brock Purdy, posting a 6-109-1 line on seven targets in his first game action since Week 6. If Evans' Achilles issue flares up at any point, Allen may be thrust into WR1 duties, which could yield more consistent results as he becomes more acclimated to head coach Kyle Shanahan's…

news.headline: Herbert caught two of his three targets for seven yards during Sunday's 35-13 loss versus the Chiefs. He also returned six kickoffs for 168 yards.
news.story: Herbert was targeted three times for the second straight game in Week 10, but he continued to make a bigger impact on special teams. His first kickoff return of the day went for 39 yards to Atlanta's 45-yard line, but the offense promptly went three and out. He'll be hoping to keep up the momentum as a returner following the Falcons' bye in Week 11.

news.headline: Strange caught all three of his targets for 16 yards during Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants.
news.story: Strange was able to notch at least three catches for the first time since Week 6, but he still finished with fewer than 20 receiving yards for the second straight week and third time overall this year. The tight end has now reeled in 35 of 43 targets for 381 yards and two touchdowns over 10 contests during the 2026 season.

news.headline: Rudolph will start Friday's game against the Broncos, Tom Pelissero of The Ringer and Netflix reports.
news.story: In a stunning move late Tuesday night, the Steelers benched Aaron Rodgers following two straight losses to the Bengals and Eagles, where the offense didn't play well at all, as Rodgers averaged a paltry 5.1 yards per attempt. The Steelers will see if Rudolph can provide a spark for 6-4 Pittsburgh. Rudolph has made 19 career regular-season starts and has averaged 6.6 yards per attempt with a 30:22 TD:INT on 742 pass…

Evans (Achilles) was listed as limited on Thursday's practice report, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
news.story: After not practicing Wednesday, Evans' upgrade in listing one day later generally is a good sign that he has a chance to suit up Sunday versus the Seahawks. In his return from a three-game absence this past Sunday against the Vikings in Mexico City, he logged just 43 percent of the snaps but reeled off six catches (on seven targets) for 109 yards and one touchdown.

news.headline: Evans (Achilles) won't practice Wednesday, Harrison Rich of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
news.story: After a three-game (and four-week) absence due to right Achilles tendinitis, Evans returned to action during Sunday's win against the Vikings in Mexico City, recording a 43 percent offensive snap share and gathering in six of seven targets for 109 yards and one touchdown. The 49ers likely are managing Evans' workload to begin Week 12 prep, but his status nonetheless will be monitored in advance of Sunday's contest…

news.headline: Mooney did not catch any of his five targets during Sunday's 23-18 win versus the Jaguars.
news.story: Quarterback J.J. McCarthy was inefficient against a solid Jaguars defense in Week 11, completing just 18 of his 38 pass attempts for 173 yards. A couple of those 20 incompletions were intended for an open Mooney, who continued to operate in the deeper areas of the field. He'll keep hunting for a big play in Week 12 at Indianapolis.

news.headline: Njoku (shoulder) was listed as a non-participant in Thursday's practice.
news.story: Njoku also was deemed a 'DNP' on Wednesday, so the tight end presumably will need to practice Friday, in some capacity, in order to avoid an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Patriots. If Njoku ends up sidelined this weekend, Charlie Kolar and Oronde Gadsden will be in line to lead the Chargers' Week 12 TE corps.

news.headline: Njoku (shoulder) did not practice Wednesday.
news.story: The veteran tight end injured his shoulder in last Sunday's loss to the Jets but was able to return to the contest, finishing with two catches for 21 yards on four targets on 41.7 percent of the offensive snaps. It's possible Wednesday was a maintenance day.

news.headline: Njoku caught two of four passes for 28 yards during the Chargers' 27-24 loss to the Jets on Sunday.
news.story: Njoku briefly left Sunday's contest after injuring his shoulder at the end of a 13-yard catch in the first quarter. The veteran tight end was cleared to return, and he ended up finishing second on the Chargers in targets behind Ladd McConkey (eight) on a day in which Justin Herbert completed 15 of 21 passes for 131 yards and two touchdowns. Njoku and the Chargers stay home for Week 12 against the Patriots on Nov. 29.

The tight end's biggest moment of the game came in the first quarter when he secured a 23-yard touchdown pass from quarterback Bryce Young, registering his first score of the year. Evans has now caught 17 of 20 targets for 191 yards and a touchdown over 10 contests during the 2026 campaign.

news.story: Even with Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) out, Restrepo played as the Titans' WR5 against Dallas, as his 17 offensive snaps trailed all four of Carnell Tate (61), Chimere Dike (53), Elic Ayomanor (36) and Calvin Ridley (26). Restrepo played 11 of his 13 snaps in the slot, where Robinson operated prior to his injury, but it was actually Dike and Daniel Bellinger who saw the biggest boosts in slot rate with Robinson out.

news.headline: Restrepo, whom the Titans signed off their practice squad Tuesday, could be in store for more playing time out of the slot moving forward after Tennessee placed Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) on injured reserve, Mark Mihalko of USA Today reports.
news.story: A 2025 undrafted free agent who played alongside Cam Ward during their final collegiate seasons at Miami, Restrepo showed immediate chemistry with the Titans' second-year quarterback during a 40-23 loss to the Jaguars in Week 10. news.headline: Restrepo was signed to the Titans' active roster Tuesday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official website reports.
news.story: Restrepo was elevated to the active roster in Week 10 against the Jaguars, and he reeled in all three of his targets for 31 yards over 19 offensive snaps. After fellow wide receiver Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday, Restrepo will replace him on the active roster ahead of Sunday's matchup with the Cowboys.

news.story: The running back was injured in last Sunday's loss to the Jets. news.headline: Mitchell (knee) is questionable to return to Sunday's contest against the Jets.
news.story: Mitchell was briefly sidelined with a back injury in the first half before returning to action. The running back is now dealing with an apparent knee issue, placing some doubt on his chances to return to the field Sunday. In his absence, Omarion Hampton and Kimani Vidal will handle the bulk of the workload in the backfield.

news.headline: Mitchell (back) has re-entered Sunday's game against the Jets, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.
news.story: Mitchell temporarily exited the contest in the first half due to a back issue. However, he's since returned to the game as part of the kickoff-return unit. Mitchell is thus set to resume his usual role as both a backup RB and special-teams ace.

news.story: Stevenson hurt his knee in Week 9 against Green Bay and initially appeared slated to miss multiple games. However, he surprisingly was able to suit up in Week 10 against Detroit in Munich, Germany, though he logged just a 44 percent offensive snap share and gained only five yards on seven touches. Etienne rushed six times for 29 yards, caught one pass for seven yards, logged 36 kickoff-return yards and recorded eight punt-return yards in the Panthers' 35-33 win over the Ravens on Sunday.
news.story: Etienne did it all in Week 11 while only playing 10 offensive snaps and nine special-teams snaps. Despite the modest playing time, the running back made an impact across the box score. Etienne continues to be the reserve option behind bell-cow back Chuba Hubbard, whose role is as entrenched as any player at his position in the league.

news.headline: Etienne took three carries for one yard and caught both of his two targets for nine yards during Sunday's 20-17 win at New Orleans. He also returned three punts for 43 yards.
news.story: Etienne again played second fiddle to starter Chuba Hubbard in Week 10 with Jonathon Brooks sidelined by a groin injury, and Etienne got his second-most touches of the season. His role on offense in Week 11 will depend on Brooks' status, but the vast majority of the Panthers' snaps at tailback will continue to go to Hubbard.

news.story: Waddle sustained a concussion in the Broncos' last game in Week 9 at Carolina, but with the benefit of a Week 10 bye, he had enough time to gain clearance from the protocol for head injuries and miss no additional time as a result. With a 24-yard connection with QB Bo Nix on Sunday, Waddle now has recorded exactly one catch of at least that distance in four straight games. Unfortunately for Waddle's fantasy…

news.headline: Waddle (concussion) doesn't carry an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Raiders after practicing fully this week.
news.story: Waddle was limited to just 14 snaps and one catch for 22 yards before exiting the Broncos' Week 9 win over the Panthers with a concussion. Following a well-time Week 10 bye, Waddle has progressed through the NFL's concussion protocol, ensuring that Denver's top pass catcher -- who has recorded a 30/337/2 receiving line on 52 targets through nine contests -- will be available this weekend.

news.story: It was easily Engram's best performance of the season, as he set season highs in targets, catches and yards against Las Vegas. news.story: Bateman was limited in Wednesday's session due to a groin injury, but his full practice Thursday puts the sixth-year wide receiver on track to play against the Texans on Sunday. He hauled in his second touchdown of the year in a Week 11 loss to the Panthers and is up to a 25-403-2 receiving line on 42 targets through 11 regular-season games.

news.headline: Bateman (groin) was limited in Wednesday's practice.

Bateman is averaging 2.3 catches per game for 36.6 yards with two total touchdowns across 11 contests.

news.story: A.J. Brown (hamstring) returned from a two-game absence caused by ankle and knee injuries in Week 10, and as a result, Chism saw his lowest snap count this season (8) since he was a healthy scratch in Week 1. His role coming out of the Patriots' bye in Week 11 will probably depend heavily on the availability of Brown, who picked up a hamstring issue against the Lions.

news.headline: Bryant caught three passes for 32 yards on four targets in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.
news.story: The wideout briefly exited the game in the third quarter after he appeared to tweak his previously injured ankle, but Bryant quickly returned and was able to finish out the contest. His four targets were fourth on the team on a day Bo Nix targeted nine different players on 35 pass attempts. The Denver offense spreads the ball around to five different receivers, three tight ends and its running backs most weeks,…

news.story: Bryant's time away from the field occurred in the middle of the third quarter. He'll look to build upon the 3-32-0 line on three targets that he accrued to that point in the contest.

news.story: Head coach Shane Steichen said Monday that McGowan "will miss some time" but didn't specify how long the absence may be. For however long McGowan is sidelined, Giddens figures to serve as Jonathan Taylor's backup at running back. Giddens has shown some flashes this season in limited playing time, amassing 48 yards on seven carries (6.9 YPC) and catching his only target for 11 yards over three games.

news.headline: Giddens rushed one time for five yards and caught his lone target for 11 yards in Thursday night's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
news.story: With Seth McGowan (hamstring) exiting early with an injury, Giddens spelled Jonathan Taylor and played seven offensive snaps. Through three games this season, Giddens has rushed seven times for 48 yards and registered one catch for 11 yards. If McGowan's injury costs him time, Giddens figures to handle RB2 duties in his absence.

news.headline: Coach Mike LaFleur has ruled out Carson Beck (back) for Sunday's game against the Commanders, which sets the stage for Johnson to start the contest, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.
news.story: Johnson, who completed 18 of 31 passes for 155 yards and a touchdown in a 34-7 loss to Kansas City in Week 11, is thus set to make his second straight start for the Cardinals. With no teams on bye this week, Johnson's Week 12 fantasy utility is limited to Superflex formats and to fantasy managers scrambling for a short-term injury replacement at the QB position.

news.headline: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Wednesday that Johnson is preparing to start Sunday's game versus the Commanders due to Carson Beck's back injury, Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site reports.
news.story: Beck won't practice Wednesday due to continued issues with back spasms, which held him out of this past Sunday's loss in Kansas City. In place of Beck, Johnson completed 18 of 31 passes for 155 yards and one touchdown while also taking two carries for five yards. Friday's injury report will reveal if Beck has a chance to play in Week 12, and by proxy if Johnson will get another spot start.

news.headline: Johnson completed 18 of 31 passes for 155 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-7 loss to Kansas City. he added five yards on two carries.
news.story: The 40-year-old QB was pressed into duty with rookie Carson Beck (back) on the shelf, and Johnson unsurprisingly wasn't really up to the task after the Cardinals fell into a 14-0 hole before the first quarter was over. news.story: After a quiet first half, Gordon got free for a 24-yard run on the first possession of the second half to set up Miami's third and final field goal of the afternoon. Gordon was Miami's most effective offensive player as usual, as Kyle McCord threw for just 102 yards in the latter's second NFL start. news.story: Ridley reeled in multiple passes in a contest for the first time since Week 5, and his 12-yard touchdown connection with Cam Ward in the fourth quarter was the wideout's first score of the year. Ridley trailed only fellow wide receiver Chimere Dike (seven) in targets, and Ridley could continue to see added opportunities moving forward with Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) sidelined for the remainder of the 2026 campaign.

news.story: Badie was back on the field for Tuesday's walkthrough practice, with Denver estimating him as a full participant, per Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site. news.headline: Helm caught two of three targets for 14 yards in Sunday's 51-30 loss to the Cowboys.
news.story: The tight end has yet to catch a touchdown this season and was unable to get anything going against arguably the league's worst defense Sunday. Helm has been held below 30 receiving yards in nine of 10 games this season. He's nothing more than a low-end TE2 in fantasy.

news.headline: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Wednesday that Johnson is preparing to start Sunday's game versus the Commanders due to Carson Beck's back injury, Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site reports.

news.story: Pittman last played in Week 4 but is slated to be back in the lineup versus Denver after logging 'full' practice listings Tuesday through Thursday. In his return, Pittman will bolster a Pittsburgh WR corps that also features DK Metcalf, Germie Bernard and Roman Wilson, with the veteran pass catcher's Week 12 fantasy upside hinging on how well he connects with newly-installed starting QB Mason Rudolph. Prior to his…

news.headline: The Steelers activated Pittman (foot) from injured reserve Thursday.
news.story: Pittman has tended to a foot injury for most of the season and spent the last six games on injured reserve. He so far has logged full listings on both of the Steelers' Week 12 practice reports, and Thursday's report will determine if he has a designation for Friday's game against the Broncos. With QB Aaron Rodgers getting waived Wednesday, Mason Rudolph is slated to lead Pittsburgh's offense.

news.headline: Pittman (foot) was listed as a full participant in Wednesday's practice,Alan Saunders of SteelersNow.com reports.
news.story: Pittman also logged a full participation listing one day before, but the Steelers held a walkthrough practice Tuesday, so Wednesday's session is more relevant with regard to the WR's availability for Friday's game against the Broncos. If Pittman -- who last saw game action in Week 4 -- is activated to face Denver, he'll be catching passing in Week 12 from Mason Rudolph, with the Steelers slated to let veteran…

news.headline: Trautman caught his only target for a one-yard touchdown during Sunday's 38-24 win versus the Raiders.
news.story: Trautman leaked open behind Las Vegas' defense on a play-action pass from the goal line early in the second quarter, giving Denver a 10-0 lead. He still has a big role in the Broncos' offense, but he isn't running enough routes to sustain pass-catching production worth fantasy consideration in most formats.

news.headline: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that DeVito is the team's starting quarterback, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports. "We're excited about that. He had a good preseason, and Tommy's improved," Vrabel said of DeVito.
news.story: With Drake Maye (fibula) hurt early in Week 10 against Detroit, DeVito stepped in at quarterback but managed to complete just 12 of 24 pass attempts for 81 yards, a touchdown and an interception. He added 19 yards on four carries. The 28-year-old does have some starting experience -- he helmed the Giants offense for eight starts between 2023 and 2024 -- but he didn't play at all in 2025. For now, the Patriots are…

news.headline: Head coach Mike Vrabel said Friday that DeVito will start in Week 12 against the Chargers on Nov. 29, Mike Reiss and Adam Schefter of ESPN.com report.
news.story: Drake Maye was diagnosed with a fractured right fibula, which he sustained in the first quarter of the Patriots' 35-10 loss to the Lions in Week 10 in Munich. DeVito filled in for the rest of that contest and completed 12 of 24 passes for 81 yards, one touchdown and one interception while turning four carries into 19 yards. DeVito looks like he'll be New England's starter coming out of the bye, with rookie…

news.headline: Wallace finished Sunday's loss to Kansas City with four catches for 57 yards on seven targets.
news.story: Wallace began the season on the Cardinals' practice squad and didn't play in his first NFL game until Week 9 versus Seattle. After logging a total of seven offensive snaps and one catch across his first two contests, the rookie paced Arizona wideouts in targets, receptions and receiving yards. Wallace also ranked second among the wideout corps with 36 offensive snaps, so it appears there was a conscious effort to…

news.headline: Wallace recorded a nine-yard reception on his lone target in Sunday's 34-6 loss to the Rams.
news.story: Though he played just five of the Cardinals' 35 snaps on offense, Wallace was able to come away with his first NFL reception in the third quarter. Even if Wallace earns more playing time in future weeks, he'll likely struggle to produce meaningful fantasy lines while rookie third-round pick Carson Beck continues to direct the offense behind a shaky offensive line.

news.headline: Fehoko caught one of five targets for a two-yard touchdown in Sunday's 34-7 loss to the Chiefs.
news.story: The wideout led his position group by playing 52 of 56 offensive snaps, and he ran a team-high 34 routes on Josh Johnson's 37 dropbacks. It didn't translate to much production outside of the short touchdown, as Fehoko has consistently shown he can't win enough as an NFL receiver. He's been thrust into heavy snaps due to a litany of injuries in Arizona. Fehoko can mostly be ignored in fantasy until he shows…

news.headline: Fehoko finished Sunday's 34-6 loss to the Rams with one catch on two targets for 21 yards. He also recorded a tackle.
news.story: Week 10 was the Cardinals' first game with rookie third-rounder Carson Beck as the starting quarterback. The offense struggled to move the ball and logged only 35 snaps as a whole while finishing with 17:37 in time of possession. That meant less opportunities for Fehoko and the rest of the Cardinals' skill-position players, although the sixth-year pro did connect with Beck on a 21-yard pass early in the first…

news.story: Darnold missed the Seahawks' last two games while tending to a pair of injuries, but he appears to be feeling healthier coming out of a Week 11 bye. news.headline: Burks was targeted three times for zero catches, had one kick return for 10 yards and made one tackle on kick coverage during the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday night.
news.story: Burks was the No. 2 wide receiver for the Colts in the contest. Despite being targeted three times, the wide receiver could not haul in any passes from since-cut quarterback Daniel Jones. Burks played 32 offensive snaps and two special-teams snaps in the contest.

news.headline: Burks failed to haul in either of his two targets during the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. He also recorded one tackle on special teams.
news.story: With Josh Downs and Keenan Allen being shipped off at the Nov. 10 deadline, the Colts turned to Burks, Laquon Treadwell and Anthony Gould to serve as the top wideouts for Week 10. news.headline: Harrison (hamstring) was a full participant in Thursday's practice.
news.story: Harrison has missed the Texans' last two contests, but after a limited practice Wednesday, the wideout's full participation Thursday sets the stage for him to return to action Sunday against the Ravens. news.headline: Harrison (hamstring) was listed as a limited participant in Wednesday's practice.
news.story: Harrison has been sidelined for the Texans' last two contests, but the WR's ability to practice Wednesday, albeit in a limited fashion, bodes well for his chances of being available for Sunday's game against the Ravens. Harrison's fantasy impact in three outings with Houston since coming over in a trade with Arizona has been modest, so we'd like to see the No. 4 overall pick in the 2024 NFL draft get a full and…

news.headline: Harrison (hamstring) was at practice Wednesday, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.
news.story: Harrison has missed two straight games, but his looming practice participation, in any capacity, is a good sign regarding his availability as Sunday's game against the Ravens approaches. The Texans' upcoming injury report will reveal the wideout's official participation level in Wednesday's session.

news.headline: Treadwell failed to catch his lone target in Thursday night's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
news.story: Treadwell played a position-high 40 of 50 offensive snaps but continues to run wind sprints in an offense that doesn't throw the ball down the field. Through 11 games this season, Treadwell has just 19 catches for 239 yards and one touchdown on 33 targets.

news.headline: Fantasy football free agent pickups: Replacing Drake Maye? Trust in Tyson?
Granson logged all 16 of his snaps on special teams in Sunday's 51-30 loss to the Cowboys.
news.story: Granson displayed some pass-catching ability in his first five seasons in the league between stops with the Colts and Eagles, but the Titans have deployed him almost exclusively on special teams in 2026. He's been active for just four of the team's first 10 contests and has drawn just one target while playing three total snaps on offense.

news.headline: Gadsden went without a target while taking the field for 23 of the Chargers' 60 snaps on offense in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.
news.story: Gadsden ranked third in snaps among Chargers tight ends, finishing only slightly behind Charlie Kolar (30) and David Njoku (25). Despite arguably being the most talented pass catcher of the trio, Gadsden was the only one of the three who failed to draw a target in Week 11. The 2025 fifth-round pick has endured a disappointing sophomore campaign, having thus far put together a 20-179-1 receiving line on 30 targets…

news.headline: Gadsden hauled in his lone target for seven yards in Monday's 23-20 win over Baltimore.

news.story: Gould was the rather unlikely leader in receiving yards for the Colts on the night, with a team-high 31-yard catch playing a big role in getting him there. The 2024 fifth-round pick has seen an expanded role in the wake of the trades of Josh Downs and Keenan Allen, and for as long as Alec Pierce (IR, heel) is sidelined, Gould could function as one of Indianapolis' top downfield threats for either Daniel Jones,…

news.headline: Gould (toe) is active for Thursday night's game against the Texans.
news.story: Gould was listed as questionable but is good to go for the divisional affair. He played 32 of 59 offensive snaps last Sunday against Miami, the Colts' first game since trading both Josh Downs and Keenan Allen. Gould manned the slot role vacated by Downs and secured two of four targets for 28 yards. He's a non-flashy but viable click in PPR-based fantasy formats.

news.headline: Gould (toe) is listed as questionable for Thursday night's game against the Texans, Abby Halpin of the Colts' official site reports.
news.story: Gould was deemed limited on Monday and Tuesday's practice reports, but he upgraded to a full listing on Wednesday's practice estimate. That suggests that the WR has a solid chance of being available Thursday, but those in leagues deep enough to consider Gould in PPR formats will need to check his availability ahead of the Colts' 8:15 pm ET kickoff. Gould was listed as a starter for this past Sunday's win over the…

news.headline: Zaccheaus caught two of his four targets for 17 yards and returned five punts for 81 yards during Atlanta's loss Sunday versus the Chiefs.
news.story: Zaccheaus recorded a season-high 17 receiving yards during the loss while playing 29 snaps on offense and 14 on special teams. The 29-year-old has hauled in eight passes for 43 yards in addition to amassing 231 kick-return yards and 81 punt-return yards across nine games this season.

news.headline: Johnson caught his only target for 15 yards during Sunday's 23-18 win versus the Jaguars.
news.story: Johnson was third in offensive snaps (14) among Giants tight ends Sunday behind starter Isaiah Likely (49) and veteran Chris Manhertz (19). With that said, Johnson did manage to record at least one catch for the fourth time in his last five games. As long as Likely remains available, though, Johnson will remain in a rotational role.

Young completed 22 of 30 passes for 254 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 35-33 win over Baltimore.
news.story: The fourth-year QB posted his best single-game completion rate of the season (73.3 percent) while tossing multiple TDs for the third time in the last six contests, a stretch in which he's compiled a 9:5 TD:INT. Both of Young's scores came in the first half, as he connected with Mitchell Evans on a 23-yard TD and Tetairoa McMillan on a seven-yard strike. Young will look to keep rolling in Week 12 against Tampa Bay.

news.headline: Young was listed with a sore foot on Wednesday's injury report but was a full participant in the Panthers' first Week 11 practice.
news.story: Per Steve Reed of the Associated Press, head coach Dave Canales said that Young experienced some soreness in his foot coming out of Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints. However, after receiving treatment over the last couple of days, Young responded well enough to take every rep in practice to kick off Week 11 prep. The signal-caller isn't expected to face any limitations during this Sunday's matchup with the Ravens.

news.headline: Endries caught four of five targets for 33 yards during Monday night's 22-20 loss to the Commanders.
news.story: Endries reeled in a career-high four passes while playing 15 snaps on offense in Week 11. The rookie is still behind Mike Gesicki and Drew Sample in the pecking order at tight end ahead of Week 12 versus the Saints.

news.headline: Brown went without a target while playing eight of the Colts' 50 offensive snaps in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
news.story: For the second week in a row, Brown ended up seeing more snaps on special teams (11) than offense. Through four games with Indianapolis, Brown has drawn just one target, which he turned into a seven-yard reception during a Week 6 loss to the Titans.

Stroud completed 21 of 26 passes for 194 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and rushed six times for 27 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
news.story: Stroud's night got off to a rocky start when a deflected pass resulted in an interception on the Texans' opening drive, but the red-hot signal-caller was near perfect from that point forward. The 2023 first-round pick went on to toss three touchdown passes for the second straight game and multiple scores for the fifth consecutive contest overall. Stroud connected with Nico Collins (42 yards), Kayshon Boutte (24…

news.headline: Bell caught one of his four targets for eight yards in the Dolphins' 26-9 loss to the Bills on Sunday.
news.story: Bell saw 34 offensive snaps in Sunday's contest but was inefficient with his opportunities. The Dolphins continues to try to involve the third-round rookie, but he's been frequently out of sync with quarterbacks Malik Willis (IR, abdomen) and Kyle McCord.

news.headline: Bell (chest) has returned to Sunday's Week 11 matchup against the Bills, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
news.story: Bell suffered a chest injury late in the first half and was subsequently deemed questionable to return. However, the rookie wideout got back into the game shortly after halftime. Bell will look to be more productive after finishing the first half without a reception.

news.headline: Bell suffered a chest injury during Sunday's game at Buffalo.
news.story: Bell took a big hit to the chest on QB Kyle McCord's interception with 18 seconds remaining in the first half, remaining on the turf for a spell before making his way to the sideline under his own power. He had no catches on his three targets at the time of his exit.

news.headline: Hibner recorded two catches for 12 yards on two targets in Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Panthers.
news.story: Hibner logged 35 of 65 snaps on offense, with his 54 percent share ranking second to only Mark Andrews (62 percent) among Ravens tight ends. The rookie fourth-round pick out of SMU's playing time has held steady between 30 and 60 percent of snaps over his 10 appearances, with Hibner drawing no more than two targets in any of those contests.

news.headline: McCord completed 12 of 33 passes for 102 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills. He also rushed twice for nine yards.
news.story: McCord has thrown for just 311 yards without a touchdown pass in his first two NFL starts. The 2025 sixth-round pick of the Eagles is poised to make at least two more starts while Malik Willis (abdomen) is on IR. Miami's lone win of the season came against the Jets, whom the Dolphins will host in Week 12.

news.headline: Taylor caught two passes for 25 yards on two targets in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
news.story: The Jets controlled this game from start to finish and never trailed, so Geno Smith attempted just 21 passes to 37 run plays for New York. Taylor's 25 yards were his most in a game since Week 7, and he's totaled just 10 catches for 75 yards and no touchdowns over his last four contests. He's a very risky play as a fantasy tight end.

news.headline: With Omar Cooper (ankle) ruled out, coach Aaron Glenn said Friday that Taylor could see more pass-catching opportunities Sunday against the Chargers.
news.story: Isaiah Williams (ribs) also has been ruled out for the Jets, so they'll be down their Nos. 3 and 4 receivers, which could lead to more multiple-tight end sets for New York. Taylor is averaging 2.8 catches for 20.9 yards per game this season. He's a touchdown-or-bust fantasy bet.

news.story: Jennings made his return to action after missing two games with a calf injury. The 29-year-old reeled in a season-high three passes, while his six targets were also the most he's had in a game this year. The wide receiver has yet to exceed 40 receiving yards in contest, and Jennings hasn't scored a touchdown this season. His next chance to accomplish both feats will come in Week 12 versus the Falcons.

news.headline: Jennings (calf) practiced in full Wednesday.
news.story: Jennings sat out the last two games due to a calf injury, but his return to all activity Wednesday gives the Vikings' receiving corps a boost after Jordan Addison was lost for at least a few weeks due to a broken thumb that required surgery. As for Jennings, he'll have a prime opportunity to work opposite No. 1 WR Justin Jefferson as he looks to build upon his 6-54-0 line on 10 targets in his six appearances this…

news.headline: Yurosek failed to draw a target while playing 29 of the Vikings' 67 offensive snaps in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers in Mexico City.
news.story: Since being reinstated from injured reserve in Week 5, Yurosek has cleared 40 percent snap shares in five of the Vikings' ensuing six games. However, he remains a fringe part of the passing attack, having thus far mustered a 3-41-0 receiving line on four targets. He ran routes on just nine of his 29 snaps in Week 11, with Yurosek mainly serving as a blocker during his time on the field.

news.headline: Schultz (illness) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.
news.story: Schultz wasn't listed on Wednesday's injury report, which indicates that the illness is a new concern for the veteran tight end. A full session Friday would likely be enough for him to avoid an injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Ravens. Brevin Jordan (finger/foot), Foster Moreau and Marlin Klein would all be in line for larger roles on offense in the event that Schultz is not cleared to play in…

news.headline: Schultz brought in his only target for 11 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
news.story: Schultz had a minimal role on a night when C.J. Stroud threw for a modest 194 yards and recorded completions to nine different targets. The veteran tight end now has consecutive one-catch, 11-yard tallies after recording multiple receptions in each of his first eight games of the season, and Schultz's production will remain hard to trust heading into a Week 12 home matchup against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 29.

news.headline: Cuevas caught one of three targets for eight yards during Sunday's 35-33 loss at Carolina.
news.story: Cuevas continues to draw targets at an impressive clip, tallying three for his second straight game despite only being on the field for 14 of the Ravens' 61 offensive snaps in Week 11. Barring an injury to starter Mark Andrews or rookie fourth-rounder Matt Hibner, though, his role isn't big enough to warrant fantasy consideration in most formats. Baltimore will take on the Texans in Week 12.

news.headline: Cuevas caught all three of his targets for 37 yards during Monday night's 23-20 loss to the Chargers.
news.story: Cuevas had an immediate connection with new starting quarterback Jacoby Brissett, reeling in at least three passes for the second time this season and the first time since Week 6. The tight end ranked fourth at his position with 11 offensive snaps, sitting behind Mark Andrews (40), Matthew Hibner (22) and Nick Vannett (14). Cuevas has now caught 13 of 16 targets for 171 yards and a touchdown over 10 contests so far…

news.headline: Jordan (foot/illness) has been ruled out ahead of Thursday night's game against the Colts.
news.story: Jordan missed all three Week 11 practice sessions due to an injury and an illness. The tight end will miss a second straight game, this time with two separate issues as opposed to the finger injury that plagued him ahead of Week 10. Marlin Klein or Cade Stover is set to be the No. 3 tight end behind Dalton Schultz and Foster Moreau for Thursday night's contest.

news.headline: Jordan (foot/illness) did not participate at practice Tuesday.
news.story: Jordan missed Sunday's game at Cleveland because of a finger injury, but it's now a foot issue and an illness that's keeping him off the practice field. If he doesn't practice in some capacity Wednesday, he'll probably end up listed as out for Thursday's game versus the Colts.

news.headline: Fantasy buzz: Joe Milton, Jahmyr Gibbs served up a fantasy feast on Thanksgiving
Gesicki brought in five of six targets for 77 yards in the Bengals' 22-20 loss to the Commanders on Monday night.
news.story: The veteran tight end finished with a team-high yardage total while coming just a yard short of equaling his best tally of the season as well. Gesicki's biggest catch came late in the fourth quarter on the Bengals' final drive, when he hauled in a 32-yard pass from Joe Burrow over the middle to get the Bengals down to the Commanders' 33-yard line. Gesicki's production continues to have some game-to-game volatility,…

news.headline: What to know to set your lineup: Nix, Ward viable options if your QB is on bye
Fant caught two of his five targets for 19 yards in the Saints' 21-13 loss to the Bears on Sunday.
news.story: Fant played 49 offensive snaps in Sunday's contest. The starting tight end was on the field for 69 percent of the team's offensive plays but remains off the same page with quarterback Tyler Shough. The tight end's five targets are the most attention he has seen since Week 1 against the Lions.

news.headline: Coach Kellen Moore said Thursday that Johnson (hamstring/wrist) is considered day-to-day ahead of Sunday's game against the Bengals, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.
news.story: Per Ross Jackson of WWL-TV, Johnson -- who logged a 'DNP' on Wednesday's practice estimate -- wasn't spotted at Thursday's session. The tight end thus has one more chance to practice before the Saints' Week 12 injury designations are assigned. If Johnson ends up limited or out this weekend, Noah Fant and Oscar Delp would be in line for added snaps in the team's offense this weekendi.

news.headline: Johnson (hamstring) did not practice Wednesday due to a hamstring/wrist issue, Katherine Terrell of ESPN reports.
news.story: Johnson was listed as having both hamstring and wrist injuries. He injured the hamstring in Sunday's loss to the Bears, but this is the first report of a wrist issue. Head coach Kellen Moore said that Johnson is "day-to-day," according to Terrell. If Johnson does not progress in time for Sunday's game, Noah Fant and Oscar Delp would be the Saints' primary tight-end options.

news.headline: Saints head coach Kellen Moore said Monday that Johnson is still undergoing further medical evaluation after injuring his hamstring during Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears, Ross Jackson of WWL-TV reports.
news.story: The Saints expect to have a better feel for Johnson's status Wednesday, when the team holds its first practice of Week 12. Before exiting Sunday in the third quarter, Johnson was targeted just once and failed to record a reception for the second time in 10 appearances on the season. If the hamstring injury prevents Johnson from playing next weekend in Cincinnati, Noah Fant and Oscar Delp would be in line for added…

news.headline: Delp hauled in his lone target for a six-yard reception in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears.
news.story: The rookie third-round pick out of Georgia has handled a muted role at tight end behind Juwan Johnson and Noah Fant this season, compiling five receptions for 26 yards on five targets through nine appearances. Delp was limited to just 21 of the Saints' 72 offensive snaps in Week 11, but he could see his playing time pick up if the hamstring injury that knocked Johnson out of Sunday's loss early prevents him from…

Facts vs. Feelings: The facts you need to feel right about your flex decisions
Head coach Shane Steichen announced Friday that Richardson will be the Colts' starting quarterback moving forward after the team waived Daniel Jones.
news.story: Richardson made a cameo in Thursday's 26-3 loss at Houston, taking over for Jones for Indianapolis' final possession, but the former logged just a two-yard carry and two incompletions before the Texans ate up the final 6:50 of the contest. A 2023 first-round pick, Richardson himself hasn't started since Week 16 of the 2024 campaign, making just four brief appearances the past two seasons combined, but he'll have a…

news.headline: Mahertz secured his lone target for a 14-yard reception in Sunday's 23-18 win over the Jaguars.
news.story: The second-quarter reception was the first of the season for Manhertz, who had suited up for each of the Giants' previous nine games but was targeted just once. While taking the field for 19 of the Giants' 70 offensive snaps, Manhertz finished a distant second to Isaiah Likely (53 snaps) among the team's tight ends. Manhertz is expected to operate mostly as a blocker on offense while being a mainstay on the Giants'…

news.headline: Cameron caught three of seven targets for 44 yards during Sunday's 23-18 loss against the Giants. He also returned two kickoffs for a total of 40 yards.
news.story: Despite being on the field for only 25 of the Jaguars' 68 offensive snaps in Week 11, Cameron drew a career-high seven targets. He wasn't terribly efficient on those targets, but neither was Jacksonville's offense as a whole Sunday. He'll be lining up against a much softer pass defense in a Week 12 tilt versus the Titans.

news.headline: Strange caught all three of his targets for 16 yards during Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants.
news.story: Strange was able to notch at least three catches for the first time since Week 6, but he still finished with fewer than 20 receiving yards for the second straight week and third time overall this year. The tight end has now reeled in 35 of 43 targets for 381 yards and two touchdowns over 10 contests during the 2026 season.

news.headline: Thomas caught one pass for an 18-yard touchdown on three targets in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants.
news.story: Thomas' three targets were a distant fourth on the team, as Parker Washington (17), Jakobi Meyers (10) and Josh Cameron (seven) combined to see a combined 34 looks on Trevor Lawrence's 47 pass attempts. Thomas ran 32 routes, 14 more than Cameron as the Jaguars' nominal WR3, but the former hasn't been seeing meaningful target volume for months. After drawing nine targets in Week 2, Thomas has averaged 2.1 targets…

news.headline: Head coach Liam Coen said Friday that it will be tough to pivot to an increased role for Hunter at wide receiver on short notice after Parker Washington (shoulder) was ruled out for Sunday's game against the Titans, Demetrius Harvey of the Florida…
news.story: Washington's shoulder injury seems to have taken a sudden turn for the worse, but the Jaguars had been preparing for their top receiver to be available, so they hadn't been utilizing Hunter much on offense in practice. Hunter should hold down his usual outside cornerback role on defense, but it's likely that most of the targets vacated by Washington will go to some combination of Jakobi Meyers (ankle), Brian…

news.headline: Hunter caught his lone target for three yards, added a nine-yard carry and logged six tackles (four solo) during the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
news.story: As has been the case for most of the 2026 season, Hunter spent the majority of his time on the field playing defense, and his six tackles were fourth most on the Jaguars. He had a quiet day offensively, and the second-year pro is up to a 10-94-1 line on 11 targets through 10 regular-season games. On the defensive side of the ball, Hunter is up to 42 tackles (28 solo) and seven pass defenses (including three…

Why fantasy managers should still trust Trevor Lawrence
Week 11 winners and losers: Cowboys put up points while Josh Allen does not
Boerkircher didn't draw a target while playing 22 of the Jaguars' 72 snaps on offense in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants.
news.story: Though quarterback Trevor Lawrence dropped back a season-high 50 times on the day and targeted nine different players, Boerkircher wasn't able to earn a look in the passing game. The second-round rookie out of Texas A&M is regarded mainly as a run-blocking specialist, but he had carved out a minor role in the passing attack with at least one reception in each of Jacksonville's previous six contests.

news.headline: Allen caught one pass for minus-1 yard in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
news.story: Allen played 14 offensive snaps behind Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) and Chris Rodriguez, and Tuten ended up aggravating his ankle issue in the defeat. If Tuten needs to miss time, Allen could see elevated snaps behind Rodriguez, though Ameer Abdullah also is an option for the Jaguars out of the backfield. Ultimately, Allen is much likelier than not to remain irrelevant in fantasy.

news.headline: Allen (hamstring) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Giants.
news.story: Allen has next to no fantasy appeal having played a total of 73 offensive snaps this season. In nine games, he's touched the ball a total of three times on offense.

news.headline: Allen (hamstring) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice, Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.
news.story: Allen is one of three Jaguars running backs on the Week 11 injury report, with Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) and Chris Rodriguez (hand) also tending to health concerns. After being listed as a non-participant Thursday, Tuten appears to be more at risk of sitting out Sunday against the Giants than either Allen or Rodriguez, both of whom have been limited in the Jaguars' first two Week 11 practices.

news.headline: Koziol went without a target while playing four of the Jaguars' 72 snaps on offense in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants.
news.story: The rookie fifth-round pick saw his streak of three straight games with a reception come to an end and also had his snap count decline for the fourth week in a row. Koziol ranked fourth in playing time among Jacksonville tight ends, marking the first time since Week 3 that he had played behind Quintin Morris (11 snaps Sunday).

news.headline: Morris went without a target while logging 11 of the Jaguars' 72 snaps on offense in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants.
news.story: For the first time since Week 3, Morris earned more playing time on offense than rookie Tanner Koziol (four snaps), who had previously been serving as the Jaguars' No. 3 tight end. Koziol offers more of a pass-catching threat at the position, but Morris is the superior blocker and also has a more integral role on special teams.

news.headline: Martin-Robinson played all but one of his 24 snaps on special teams in Sunday's 51-30 loss to the Cowboys.
news.story: The third-year tight end out of Temple is a core contributor on special teams but has been an afterthought on offense throughout the season. Martin-Robinson hasn't played double-digit snaps on offense in any of his nine appearances and has yet to draw a target.

news.headline: Sadiq caught all three of his targets for 30 yards during Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
news.story: Sadiq finished tied for second on the team in targets with wide receiver Adonai Mitchell and running back Breece Hall behind wideout Garrett Wilson (five). The tight end was able to reel in multiple passes for just the second time since catching seven of eight targets for 105 yards and a score in Week 3 against the Lions. Sadiq has now caught 25 of 36 targets for 268 yards and a score while adding a three-yard…

news.headline: With Omar Cooper (ankle) ruled out, coach Aaron Glenn said Friday that Sadiq could see more pass-catching opportunities Sunday against the Chargers.
news.story: In addition to Cooper, Isaiah Williams (ribs) also will be sidelined against Los Angeles. Sadiq could essentially handle WR3 duties behind Garrett Wilson and Adonai Mitchell, though it's not the easiest matchup against the Los Angeles defense. Sadiq has a chance to see elevated snaps, which could translate to more targets in the passing game, but he's still difficult to get behind as a fantasy starter.

news.headline: Kacmarek went without a target while logging 21 of 57 snaps on offense in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills.
news.story: After drawing at least one target in each of the previous three games, Kacmarek failed to draw a look from quarterback Kyle McCord, who connected with seven different pass catchers on the day. Kacmarek ran routes on just six of his 21 snaps, as the Dolphins continue to utilize him mainly as a blocker when he's on the field.

news.headline: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that DeVito is the team's starting quarterback, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports. "We're excited about that. He had a good preseason, and Tommy's improved," Vrabel said of DeVito.
news.story: With Drake Maye (fibula) hurt early in Week 10 against Detroit, DeVito stepped in at quarterback but managed to complete just 12 of 24 pass attempts for 81 yards, a touchdown and an interception. He added 19 yards on four carries. The 28-year-old does have some starting experience -- he helmed the Giants offense for eight starts between 2023 and 2024 -- but he didn't play at all in 2025. For now, the Patriots are…

news.headline: Head coach Mike Vrabel said Friday that DeVito will start in Week 12 against the Chargers on Nov. 29, Mike Reiss and Adam Schefter of ESPN.com report.
news.story: Drake Maye was diagnosed with a fractured right fibula, which he sustained in the first quarter of the Patriots' 35-10 loss to the Lions in Week 10 in Munich. DeVito filled in for the rest of that contest and completed 12 of 24 passes for 81 yards, one touchdown and one interception while turning four carries into 19 yards. DeVito looks like he'll be New England's starter coming out of the bye, with rookie…

news.headline: Kolar brought in his lone target for eight yards during the Chargers' 27-24 loss to the Jets on Sunday.
news.story: Kolar was cleared to play Sunday after progressing through the league's concussion protocol, and his 30 offensive snaps were ahead of fellow tight ends David Njoku (25) and Oronde Gadsden (23). Kolar's eight-yard catch midway through the first quarter was the only pass that the fifth-year pro saw from Justin Herbert, but no Chargers pass catcher saw more than five targets other then Ladd McConkey (eight). Kolar has…

news.headline: Kolar (concussion) is active for Sunday's game versus the Jets.
news.story: Kolar showed up on the Chargers' first Week 11 injury report Wednesday as a non-participant due to a concussion, and thereafter he managed just one limited session Friday before the team tagged him as questionable for Sunday. Despite his inability to practice fully this week and the prospect of gaining clearance from an independent neurologist shaped up as a difficult combination to overcome, he's available to the…

news.headline: Kolar (concussion) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Jets.
news.story: The tight end is still in the concussion protocol, so he'll be up against it to clear the final hurdles, especially after the Chargers played Monday night against Baltimore. If Kolar is ruled out, David Njoku and Oronde Gadsden should handle most of the tight-end duties for the Bolts.

news.headline: Coach Mike LaFleur has ruled out Carson Beck (back) for Sunday's game against the Commanders, which sets the stage for Johnson to start the contest, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.
news.story: Johnson, who completed 18 of 31 passes for 155 yards and a touchdown in a 34-7 loss to Kansas City in Week 11, is thus set to make his second straight start for the Cardinals. With no teams on bye this week, Johnson's Week 12 fantasy utility is limited to Superflex formats and to fantasy managers scrambling for a short-term injury replacement at the QB position.

news.headline: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Wednesday that Johnson is preparing to start Sunday's game versus the Commanders due to Carson Beck's back injury, Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site reports.
news.story: Beck won't practice Wednesday due to continued issues with back spasms, which held him out of this past Sunday's loss in Kansas City. In place of Beck, Johnson completed 18 of 31 passes for 155 yards and one touchdown while also taking two carries for five yards. Friday's injury report will reveal if Beck has a chance to play in Week 12, and by proxy if Johnson will get another spot start.

news.headline: Johnson completed 18 of 31 passes for 155 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-7 loss to Kansas City. he added five yards on two carries.
news.story: The 40-year-old QB was pressed into duty with rookie Carson Beck (back) on the shelf, and Johnson unsurprisingly wasn't really up to the task after the Cardinals fell into a 14-0 hole before the first quarter was over. Johnson spent most of his afternoon finding Trey McBride for short gains, and he did hit Simi Fehoko for a two-yard score in the second quarter. Beck doesn't figure to miss much time, but if Johnson…

news.headline: Higgins caught his lone target for four yards during the Cardinals' 34-7 loss to the Chiefs on Sunday.
news.story: The Cardinals offense struggled Sunday with Josh Johnson as the starter in the absence of Carson Beck (back). Of Johnson's 31 pass attempts, 26 of them were split between Trey McBride (14), Harrison Wallace (seven) and Simi Fehoko (five), leaving very little for Higgins and the other Cardinals pass catchers. Higgins has only one catch over his last two outings and a 19-166-1 line on 21 targets through 11…

news.headline: Higgins played 24 of 35 offensive snaps (68.6 percent) but didn't get a target during the Cardinals' 34-6 loss to the Rams on Sunday.
news.story: Week 10 was Higgins' first game since signing a three-year contract extension worth up to $26.8 million. He didn't have much to show for it during Sunday's loss, although the Cardinals finished with a measly 17:37 time of possession, and the offense struggled as a whole with rookie third-rounder Carson Beck under center. Higgins will take an 18-162-1 receiving line on 20 targets through 10 games into Arizona's Week…

news.headline: Long hauled in his lone target for an 11-yard reception in Sunday's 34-7 loss to the Chiefs.
news.story: Long ranked third among Cardinals tight ends in playing time, logging 23 of 56 offensive snaps while Trey McBride (45 snaps) and Elijah Higgins (32) paced the position group. In his first two contests back in action since being reinstated from injured reserve Nov. 14 following a five-game absence, Long has notched two receptions for 18 yards on three targets.

news.headline: Bates didn't garner a target during Monday night's 22-20 win over the Bengals.
news.story: Bates went without a target for the fourth straight game. The 29-year-old's 21 offensive snaps ranked third at tight end behind Chig Okonkwo (49) and Ben Sinnott (24), and Bates should continue to have no fantasy value in Week 12 versus the Cardinals.

news.headline: Yankoff (knee) was a full participant at practice Thursday.
news.story: Yankoff sat out the Commanders' contest against the Giants in Week 10 because of a knee injury, but it now looks like he's put it behind him. He figures to resume a depth role at tight end in Week 11 against the Bengals.

news.headline: Farrell turned his lone target into a seven-yard reception in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Vikings in Mexico City.
news.story: Farrell has suited up in each of the 49ers' first 10 games, but despite logging double-digit snaps in each contest, he's produced just four catches for 40 yards on seven targets. He'll continue to serve mainly as a blocking tight end on offense while also serving as a key contributor on the 49ers' special-teams units.

news.headline: Willis went without a target while logging nine snaps on offense and 21 on special teams in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Vikings in Mexico City.
news.story: Willis has suited up in each of the 49ers' last nine games but has received little run on offense while the team's top two tight ends -- George Kittle and Luke Farrell -- have remained healthy throughout the season. The 27-year-old has logged single-digit snaps on offense in five straight contests and has yet to draw a target in 2026.

news.headline: Whiteheart was listed as full participant in Cleveland's practice estimate Thursday, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.
news.story: Whiteheart popped up on the injury report Wednesday due to a hip issue but should be good to go for Sunday's matchup versus the Raiders. The 26-year-old tight end has caught four of his seven targets for 48 yards and a touchdown across 10 games this season.

news.headline: Whiteheart (hip) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.
news.story: Whiteheart is dealing with a hip issue coming out of the Browns' Week 11 bye, but he'll have two more opportunities to practice in full and avoid an injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Raiders. The 26-year-old tight end has four catches on seven targets for 48 yards and a touchdown through 10 regular-season games.

news.headline: Otton caught one pass for eight yards on three targets in Sunday's 31-21 loss to the Lions.
news.story: The tight end earned just a 9.1 percent target share and continues to be nearly invisible in the box score despite being an every-down player who runs virtually every pass route for the Bucs. Otton has just one touchdown since Week 11 of the 2024 season and has just one career 100-yard receiving game across 73 regular-season contests. He's a touchdown-or-bust fantasy bet who clearly busts far more than he hits.

news.headline: Tremble (knee) was listed as a limited participant on Thursday's estimated practice report, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.
news.story: Tremble was cleared to play through a knee injury against the Ravens in Week 11, when he hauled in his lone target for 18 yards while playing 59 of 71 offensive snaps (83.1 percent) in a 35-33 win for the Panthers. Carolina did not practice Thanksgiving Day, so Tremble's participation over the next two days will provide clarity on his status ahead of Monday's NFC South showdown against Tampa Bay.

news.headline: Tremble caught one pass for 18 yards in Sunday's 35-33 win over the Ravens.
news.story: The tight end played on 82 percent of the offensive snaps but only saw one target. Tremble has 36 targets across 10 appearances this season, recording 26 catches for 245 yards and three scores.

news.headline: Tremble (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Ravens, Darin Gantt of the Panthers' official site reports.
news.story: Tremble opened Week 11 prep as a non-participant Wednesday due to a knee injury, which he followed up with limited sessions Thursday and Friday and a questionable tag for Sunday. The same can be said for fellow TE Darren Waller (knee), and both now are available to the Panthers offense. In nine outings this season, Tremble has compiled a 25-227-3 line on 35 targets.

news.headline: Evans (Achilles) was listed as a DNP on Thursday's estimated practice report, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.
news.story: Evans may have picked up the injury during the Panthers' 35-33 win over the Ravens this past Sunday, when he caught all five of his targets for 44 yards, which included a 23-yard grab in the first quarter. Given that the Panthers didn't practice Thanksgiving Day, Evans' practice participation over the next two days will be worth monitoring ahead of Monday's game against the Buccaneers.

news.headline: Evans caught all five of his targets for 44 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 35-33 win over the Ravens.
news.story: Evans was able to reel in a season-high five passes while notching multiple receptions for the fourth time in five weeks. The tight end's biggest moment of the game came in the first quarter when he secured a 23-yard touchdown pass from quarterback Bryce Young, registering his first score of the year. Evans has now caught 17 of 20 targets for 191 yards and a touchdown over 10 contests during the 2026 campaign.

news.headline: Durham wasn't targeted while playing 15 of the Buccaneers' 69 snaps on offense and 15 on special teams in Sunday's 31-21 loss to the Lions.
news.story: Durham's lone contribution in the box score came on the Buccaneers' first play of the day, when he recovered a fumble by quarterback Baker Mayfield. Though he's suited up for each of the Buccaneers' 10 games and has logged double-digit snaps on offense in the past six contests, Durham has recorded just one reception (for five yards) on two targets throughout the season. He's been deployed mainly as a blocking tight…

news.headline: Sharp went without a target while logging 12 of the Buccaneers' 69 offensive snaps in Sunday's 31-21 loss to the Lions.
news.story: Sharp's 17 percent offensive snap share placed him third among Tampa Bay tight ends, and he trails Cade Otton (97 percent) and Payne Durham (22 percent). The rookie sixth-round pick out of LSU has rarely seen involvement in the passing game over his limited playing time on offense this season, recording a 21-yard reception on two targets over 10 appearances.

news.headline: Kieft played all 12 of his snaps on special teams in Sunday's 31-21 loss to the Lions.
news.story: Kieft has played just 11 total snaps on offense over his nine appearances with Tampa Bay this season while Cade Otton, Payne Durham and Bauer Sharp have been prioritized ahead of him at tight end. On the rare occasions he takes the field with the offense, Kieft typically handles a blocking role. He hasn't drawn a target in any game since his second season in the NFL in 2023.

news.headline: Franks played all 21 of his snaps on special teams and was credited with two tackles in Sunday's 35-33 win over the Ravens.
news.story: Franks has been active for all 10 of the Panthers' games to date, but he's been utilized almost exclusively on special teams. He hasn't logged more than nine snaps on offense in any contest and has yet to draw a target.
